name: POST /api/admin/speech/certification-runs/claim - The voice runtime claims a queued certification run
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token), the voice runtime's only. Leases the oldest queued run to `worker` and returns the job WITH THE DECRYPTED KEYS it needs (as a call bootstrap does) — so the definition deliberately exercises only its refusals: a successful claim would hand provider keys to the test runner and hold a real run's lease. A catalog entry is certified only after its certification run passes the thresholds (c1171be1-c7ce-4c6d-acbc-98ffe825bc53#AC2): llm — tool-call accuracy, p95 time to first token, barge-in stop; stt — word error rate of phone-band (8 kHz) audio a reference TTS synthesised, and time to the final transcript; tts — time to first audio, real-time factor, intelligibility through a reference STT. Keys come from the tenant key vault; ProjexCloud holds none. An operator can no longer set certified by PATCH (409 CertificationRequiresRun). 200 { job | null }. Errors: missing worker 400; missing ops token 401.
